## SDD checklist

- [ ] Feature spec or bug report linked above.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria satisfied.
- [ ] Test plan updated.
- [ ] Implementation or fix summary updated in this PR.
- [ ] Release notes updated if change is user-visible.
- [ ] AppSource risk reviewed if applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, passwords, or credentials added.
- [ ] No external reference folders modified unintentionally.

## Scope control

- [ ] Change is limited to the described scope.
- [ ] No unrelated refactoring was included.

## AppSource safety

- [ ] App ID unchanged.
- [ ] Publisher unchanged.
- [ ] App name unchanged.
- [ ] Object ranges unchanged.
- [ ] Affixes/namespaces/dependencies/permissions reviewed.

## Tests and validation

- [ ] Build/compile completed.
- [ ] Relevant tests passed or limitations are documented.

## External guidance used

- [ ] BC Code Intelligence used where relevant.
- [ ] BCQuality used where relevant.
- [ ] Microsoft documentation checked where platform behavior was unclear.
